source_findings.detail: The first return removes the v2_request wrapper from the three selected native stale-base cases and restores their original API-1 request bodies and rebased assertions.

Those cases use fresh keys rebase-after-v2 and authority-retry. They are new requests, not historical receipt retries. Current Runtime normalizes omitted label/steps, receives provider step records, and returns merged for a moved-head fresh acceptance. The preserved rebased expectations are therefore stale against current C0 semantics, but this is not evidence of a product fault. Sol may authorize a routine expectation correction; this read-only task makes no source or test change.

The first return restores the retired HTTP setup through registered commitTimeline/doc.patch, preserves the parent payload with config.clips absent, and retains the pin/history/lost-ACK/restart/refusal/undo predicates. The central HTTP node was deselected previously; no retry or body credit is assigned.
All seven UNKNOWN cases are AST/source-hash identical to pristine base; no product source, provider registration, fixture, schema, pin, generated file, or permission was changed.

new_request.controls: api_version=1/schema_version=1 with label/steps omitted is allowed by C0
new_request.status_normative: merged when landing differs from requested base

exact_retry.control: same idempotency key and byte-identical request after first durable acceptance/restart
exact_retry.status_normative: unchanged original envelope; no provider execution or new history

historical_record.conclusion: No genuine historical rebased receipt was found in this selected cohort; do not use the archive to reclassify fresh requests.

body_status.targeted_three: existing first-return execution observed merged against preserved rebased assertions; not credited as behavior
